name: Zaggle Prepaid Ocean Services Ltd
title: Zaggle Prepaid Ocean Services Ltd - 543985 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Zaggle is a fintech spend-management platform, not a capital-cycle story; FY27 standalone revenue guided 25-30%, consolidated ~40%, EBITDA guidance withheld, and operating cash flow still negative at about INR6 crores in Q4.

triggers.label: EBITDA guidance withheld
triggers.quote: we would like to give guidance on EBITDA over the next few months once the entire integration effort completes

triggers.label: Operating cash flow about minus INR6 crores
triggers.quote: we are just about minus INR6 crores on negative cash flow

triggers.label: Propel margin 10% to 4%
triggers.quote: some of the models like the redemption model on Propel Points do take a lot of our cash flows

triggers.label: FY27 standalone growth 25-30%
triggers.quote: we are projecting our stand-alone FY27 growth to be around 25% to 30%

triggers.label: DICE asset purchase at INR68 crores
triggers.quote: for approximately INR68 crores, excluding GST, a significant optimization from the initial INR123 crores valuation

guidance.quote: we are projecting our stand-alone FY27 growth to be around 25% to 30%
with our consolidated growth for FY27 to be around 40%
we would like to give guidance on EBITDA over the next few months once the entire integration effort completes
we are going to be able to come back to around 5.5% margins in the coming years

prior_guidance_check.metric: Cash back and incentives to about 50% over 4-5 years
EBITDA margin expansion about 100 bps a year, 11-14% medium term
prior_guidance_check.quote: the ramp-up, which we would have otherwise seen probably close to 1 percentage point every year, that might go through some temporary variation

red_flags.label: Operating cash flow negative; consol about INR52 crores negative
red_flags.quote: on a consol, that is almost INR52 crores negative

red_flags.label: Trade receivables up to INR129 crores from INR40 crores
red_flags.quote: if you look at the trade receivables, they have gone up from INR40 crores to INR129 crores year-on-year

red_flags.label: Short-term borrowing despite cash
red_flags.quote: why this INR40 crores, INR50 crores short-term borrowing has come up, despite we already having cash?

red_flags.label: Evasion on other current assets and GTV split
red_flags.quote: we generally don't give a breakup or specifics on that

red_flags.label: Capitalised dev cost nearly doubled H1 to H2
red_flags.quote: your capitalized development costs have nearly doubled from INR30 crores in H1 to INR56 crores in H2 FY26

red_flags.label: US launch pushed by a couple of quarters
red_flags.quote: we have just pushed it by a couple of quarters

evasions.topic: Other current assets split (prepaid cards and vouchers)
evasions.quote: we generally don't give a breakup or specifics on that
we would like to give guidance on EBITDA over the next few months
Please let me not tie myself into any knots here by giving you any specifics, sir.
generally, we don't -- that's why we don't publish the GTV in that sense
